Problem: Insert at End in a Singly Linked List
You are given N integers.
Create a Singly Linked List and insert all elements at the end of the list.
After inserting all elements, print the linked list.
Input Format
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
N → number of nodes
Next line contains N space-separated integers
Output Format
Print the linked list elements in one line separated by space.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 1000
-10^9 ≤ ai ≤ 10^9
